# MH-23 — Register party members

**Business value:** 925

[Back to index](../README.md)

## User story

As a hiker
I want to provide the number and details of the people in my party
So that the hut knows who is taking part in the hike

<!-- Manual clarifications below this line are preserved on regeneration. -->

## Clarifications

As per MH-20 it is possible to provide no info about the party size

Since it is possible that the registering hiker do not know all information about all of the party members, is should be possible to provide partial details, i.e. not all members.
